pattern: vpn not connecting; zscaler; ssl error
resolution: Hey, Please restart the Zscaler client, then reconnect VPN. If it persists, clear local cert cache and reboot.
Run Outlook in safe mode and disable add-ins. If profile is corrupt, recreate the Outlook profile.
Use the Self-Service portal to reset your password via SSO. If locked out, contact the Service Desk.

pattern: unable to get supplier id; sap supplier fetch error
resolution:
Ensure your SAP user has read access to supplier tables (e.g., LFA1). 
Verify that the supplier record exists in SAP master data.  If the API or BAPI call fails, check network/VPN connectivity and SAP gateway logs. Try again after clearing cache or re-authenticating the SAP session.

pattern: unable to create purchase order; po creation failed; sap po error
resolution: Confirm that all mandatory fields (supplier ID, material number, plant, company code) are correctly filled. Verify user authorization for PO creation (transaction ME21N or API). If issue persists, check for backend validation errors in SAP logs (ST22 or SM21) and retry after session refresh. Ensure no duplicate PO number or locked document.
